items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: Pick a time from scrolling hour, minute and AM·PM columns in a popover, with a type-to-set header and a Clear / Cancel / Confirm footer. Here Be Dragons component with a shadcn/ui-style composition API: a controlled 24-hour HH:MM value, 12- or 24-hour display and a minute step.
